# Simplr

> Headless WordPress front end for Simplr — brand identity and digital design.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://simplr.co.za/)
- [Work](https://simplr.co.za/work/)
- [About](https://simplr.co.za/about/)
- [Services](https://simplr.co.za/services/)
- [Thinking](https://simplr.co.za/thinking/)
- [Contact](https://simplr.co.za/contact/)
- [Est. 2014](https://simplr.co.za/est-2014/)

## Dynamic content

- Work singles: https://simplr.co.za/work/:slug/
- Thinking singles: https://simplr.co.za/thinking/:topic/:slug/
- Landing pages: https://simplr.co.za/:slug/

## Technical notes

- Canonical URLs and Open Graph tags are set per route.
- JSON-LD is emitted for Organization, WebSite, CollectionPage, WebPage, Article, Service ItemList, FAQPage, and ContactPage where relevant.
- sitemap.xml and robots.txt are generated at build time.
- HTTP 301 redirects are generated from WordPress into public/_redirects.
